_comment: Build-context images for this app. CI (the image-build, publish-images jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml) iterates `images` as a matrix, so it is never hardcoded to backend+frontend: add an entry here to build and ship a new container (e.g. a widget) automatically. `service` becomes the GHCR image suffix (ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-<service>); compose.prod.yml pulls the published tags via BACKEND_IMAGE / FRONTEND_IMAGE. The server does not build these.
